ideas.pitch: An offline-first panic and route safety application for women that uses crowd-sourced lighting and crowd density data to generate safe navigation routes, paired with discreet Bluetooth BLE wearable triggers.
ideas.title: SakhiSuraksha
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Women Safety domain mandated by IEEE WIE organizers and features a tangible working prototype with a live demo, aligning with winning patterns.

ideas.pitch: A vernacular mobile application for rural farmers that uses lightweight on-device computer vision models to diagnose crop diseases and automatically cross-references them with local government agricultural scheme databases.
ideas.title: AgriSathi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on the Agriculture & Rural Innovation track with clear, measurable socio-economic impact for rural communities.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered claims assistant designed for rural and semi-urban healthcare clinics to instantly check policy coverage and fight wrongful medical bill denials by insurance providers.
ideas.title: ArogyaVerify
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts proven enterprise agent concepts to local healthcare funding structures, appealing directly to the Healthcare Innovation domain judges.

ideas.pitch: A satellite and sensor data monitoring dashboard that tracks local industrial energy consumption and carbon offset compliance for small manufacturing clusters.
ideas.title: EcoGrid Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies satellite monitoring techniques to sustainable technology, offering concrete environmental metrics that appeal to sustainability judges.

ideas.pitch: A transparent micro-lending and financial literacy platform tailored for women-led self-help groups in rural areas, utilizing graph intelligence to assess alternative credit risks.
ideas.title: MicroCred
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines FinTech Innovation with social impact for women, addressing two key criteria of the Ideathon 2026 themes simultaneously.
